result:
If I can use the word loosely: I care about meaning.

I care about not being sloppy with language, truth, or people. About honesty without cruelty. About ideas that still have some life in them instead of just being smooth. About not pretending something is simple when it isn’t. About saying nothing rather than saying something empty.
